notes.title: Hot fixes for last update
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that caused issues with obtaining achievements for collecting cats.

notes.title: Cats Are Money Update 1.020
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 💖

A new update with improvements and fixes is out! 🐾

🛠 What's new:

✨ Daily quests: timer reduced to 4 hours.
✨ Updated button layout in the game.
✨ Added achievements for the cat collection.
✨ Added achievements for collecting love.

🛠 Fixes:

✅ Fixed renaming bug — everything now works correctly.
✅ Fixed bug when purchasing new locations related to achievements.
✅ Fixed long-sale balance.
✅ Removed bugs with trash in the “Desert” location.
✅ Fixed localization in long-sale.

Thank you all for your support! 💖
Hope your kitties are full and happy! 🐾

notes.title: Cats Are Money Hotfix 1.019
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 💖

-------------------------------------------------------
✅Fixed the bug with the non-working "No" button on exit.

notes.title: Cats Are Money Update 1005
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

A new update has just been released with new localization and much more!

Thank you for playing and supporting the game! 💖

🛠 New in this update:

-------------------------------------------------------

✨ Added Spanish, German, and Chinese localization.

✨ Added the option to switch to windowed mode.

✨ Added the option for the game to continue running when minimized.

✨ Added hint arrows when new locations are unlocked.

-------------------------------------------------------

🛠 Fixes:

-------------------------------------------------------

✅ Fixed the selling price for kittens.

✅ Fixed a bug with effects.

Thank you all for supporting the game! 💖

Hope your kitties are happy! 🐾

notes.title: Cats Are Money Update 1004
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

A fresh update is here with new weather system, bug fixes, and overall improvements!

Thank you for playing and supporting the game 💖

🛠️ New Content:

-------------------------------------------------------

✨ Added a system of effects and cat states.

✨ Added a weather system that influences cats.

-------------------------------------------------------

🛠️ Bug Fixes:

-------------------------------------------------------

✅ Fixed a bug that prevented progress during the cleaning stage in the tutorial.

✅ Fixed a bug that limited clicks during cleaning after purchasing a new location.

✅ Fixed a bug that allowed infinite purchases of already-owned food skins.

-------------------------------------------------------

Thank you for playing! 💖

Your kitties are purring with happiness 🐾

notes.title: Poop Hotfix
notes.notes:
🛠 Improvements:

 Reduced the maximum number of poops that can appear on the map.
 Decreased the spawn rate of poops across all locations.

notes.title: Cats Are Money Update 1003
notes.notes:
✨ New:

 Added a collection of cats and decorative items.
 You can now change cats' names.
 New skins for cat food have been added.
 Added a save reset button.
 Added wool production penalty for cats not in their native location.
 New cats and decorations have been added to the game!


⚙ Improvements:

 Reduced upgrade costs.
 Updated tutorial for a smoother start.
 Text on some buttons now displays purchase status information.
 Offline wool generation has been made more efficient.


🛠 Bug Fixes:

 Fixed cats disappearing when changing locations.
 Fixed incorrect wool display when entering the game.
 Fixed food texture freezing during feeding.
 Fixed wool production multipliers in the tundra.
 Fixed hourly wool and love generation display.
 Fixed decoration duplication bug.
 Fixed automatic closing of cat info window.


Thank you for playing! 💖  
Your kitties are purring with happiness 🐾
